headline: COPPER SURGES TO $6.55/LB, WITHIN 2% OF US RECORD — SHANGHAI STOCKPILES COLLAPSE 82% SINCE MAY, YANGSHAN PREMIUM DOUBLES TO $115/TON
snippet: COMEX September copper futures rose to $6.55 per pound, within 2% of the all-time US record, as one of the most dramatic inventory drawdowns in recent exchange history tightened the physical market. Shanghai Futures Exchange copper inventories have collapsed 82% since early May 2026 — a pace far exceeding seasonal norms — while the Yangshan copper premium, a key barometer of Chinese import demand, has doubled to a multi-year high of $115 per tonne. Contributing factors include a China crackdown on VAT fraud that reduced scrap copper availability, typhoon-related stockpiling, and smelter maintenance cycles. The COMEX-LME arbitrage has also widened sharply as US traders price in the 15% copper import tariff scheduled for January 1, 2027. For junior copper equity investors, the physical tightening signal is significant: exchange inventory drawdowns of this speed and magnitude have historically preceded equity re-ratings by 4–8 weeks, and the current gap between copper spot prices and junior copper valuations on the TSX-V and ASX is historically wide.

headline: EQUINOX-ORLA WINS 99.9% SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL — COURT ORDER MONDAY JULY 28, DEAL CLOSES JULY 31 CREATING NORTH AMERICA'S NEW SENIOR GOLD PRODUCER
snippet: Both Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX, NYSE: EQX) and Orla Mining (TSX: ORLA, NYSE: ORLA) shareholders voted July 22, 2026 with near-unanimous approval — 99.91% of votes cast — for their share-for-share business combination. Under the arrangement, each Orla share converts into one Equinox share plus US$0.0001 cash; former Orla shareholders will own approximately 33% and existing Equinox shareholders approximately 67% of the combined company. All regulatory hurdles are cleared: Canadian and Mexican competition approvals, TSX, and NYSE American approvals are in hand. The BC Supreme Court hearing is scheduled for Monday July 28, with closing expected July 31. The combined portfolio spans gold-producing mines in Mexico (Camino Rojo), Brazil (Santa Luz, Fazenda, RDM), and exploration assets in Canada, with analysts estimating combined production potential exceeding 600,000 ounces annually once fully ramped. For TSX-listed mid-tier gold investors, the Equinox-Orla combination ends the era of two overlapping mid-tier operators in the same geographic belt and creates a consolidated vehicle that institutional buyers can position in at scale — historically a re-rating trigger for the combined entity.

headline: OSISKO METALS HITS 320m AT 0.38% Cu AT GASPÉ — 25 INFILL INTERCEPTS TARGET INFERRED-TO-INDICATED UPGRADE IN EASTERN QUÉBEC (TSX: OM)
snippet: Osisko Metals Inc. (TSX: OM) released July 23 drill results from its 2026 program at the Gaspé Copper Project in Eastern Québec, reporting 25 mineralized intercepts from 12 new drill holes — including a standout of 320.5 metres averaging 0.38% copper. The campaign is focused on infill drilling within the 2026 Mineral Resource Estimate model, specifically targeting conversion of Inferred resources to Measured and Indicated categories ahead of a feasibility study. Lateral expansion targets include the Needle East and Needle Mountain areas to the south and southwest. The Gaspé copper district is one of the most established copper systems in eastern Canada, and with copper approaching US records, Osisko's systematic upgrade campaign is a de-risking milestone for a project still priced at early-stage multiples relative to its scale.

headline: ELEMENT 29 DRILLS 1,534m AT 0.58% CuEq AT ELIDA — RECORD PERU PORPHYRY INTERCEPT EXTENDS 1,071m BEYOND CURRENT RESOURCE BOUNDARY (TSXV: ECU)
snippet: Element 29 Resources Inc. (TSXV: ECU) announced July 23 that drill hole ELID035 at its Elida Porphyry Copper-Molybdenum-Silver Deposit in central Perú returned 1,534.6 metres grading 0.58% CuEq (0.34% Cu, 0.064% Mo, 2.56 g/t Ag) from bedrock surface at 56.6m depth to end-of-hole — the longest continuous mineralized interval yet drilled at the project. Within that intercept, 1,071.1m graded 0.61% CuEq, extending mineralization well beyond the limits of the 2022 Mineral Resource Estimate, which was built on only 14,361m of drilling and ends more than 1,000m above the base of ELID035. Two rigs are active in a planned 10,000m 2026 program with 4,885m completed to date. The deep extension fundamentally reframes the project's size potential: the current open-pit resource now appears to represent only the shallowest portion of a very large copper-molybdenum porphyry system, making Elida a credible acquisition target for mid-tier producers seeking to replace copper reserves in a stable Peruvian jurisdiction.

headline: TROILUS DRILLS 103m AT 1.10 g/t AuEq IN Z87 RESERVE PIT — OPTIMIZATION PROGRAM STEADILY UPGRADING INFERRED OUNCES FOR MINE PLAN (TSX: TLG)
snippet: Troilus Mining Corp. (TSX: TLG) released July 23 results from 10 drill holes (4,230m) in its Z87 reserve pit optimization program, highlighted by 103 metres grading 1.10 g/t gold equivalent (0.98 g/t Au, 0.54 g/t Ag, 0.07% Cu) within the existing feasibility-defined pit shell. The optimization program targets upgrade of inferred material and unsampled historic intervals within the hangingwall of the main ore zone — work that translates directly to improved mine plan confidence for a pre-production gold-copper project in James Bay, Québec. Consistent above-cutoff grades from infill drilling are the foundation of a credible production schedule, and Troilus's ability to continuously confirm grade continuity while converting inferred ounces is a meaningful risk-reduction milestone that differentiates it from explorers still proving up geology.

headline: T2 METALS MAPS 15%+ CHALCOPYRITE IN FLOAT AT AURORA — NEW Cu-ANTIMONY SULPHIDE TARGETS FOUND 300m FROM UPCOMING DRILL SITES IN YUKON (TSXV: TWO)
snippet: T2 Metals Corp. (TSXV: TWO) reported July 23 that field crews at the Aurora Gold-Silver Project in Yukon's Tombstone Gold Belt discovered new copper- and antimony-bearing sulphide mineralisation during summer mapping — float samples with chalcopyrite visually estimated above 15%, and semi-massive stibnite outcropping approximately 300m from the Antimony Mountain prospect. Over 120 rock samples and 3,000 soil samples were collected across a 10km × 5km survey area. Drill site preparation is now underway for a planned rotary air blast program targeting commencement in July or August 2026. Aurora was acquired from legendary Yukon prospector Shawn Ryan in February 2026 — a provenance that carries significant geological credibility given Ryan's discovery track record in the same belt. The addition of copper-antimony targets to what began as a gold-silver project broadens the commodity thesis at precisely the moment copper prices are approaching US records and antimony is classified as a critical mineral by multiple western governments.

headline: BARRICK AND MIDLAND COMMENCE EXPLORATION ON 86 km² LEWIS PROPERTY — LOCATED 60km FROM NELLIGAN'S 8.3 MILLION OUNCES IN ABITIBI GOLD BELT (TSXV: MD)
snippet: Midland Exploration Inc. (TSXV: MD) and option partner Barrick Gold commenced the 2026 exploration program on the Lewis Project in the Abitibi gold belt on July 23, 2026, with geological mapping, structural data collection, and 167-sample till survey across 154 exploration rights covering 86 km². The Lewis option agreement dates from November 2025; the property sits approximately 60 kilometres northwest of the Nelligan deposit, which hosts 3.12 million ounces indicated at 0.85 g/t and 5.16 million ounces inferred at 0.96 g/t — a combined 8.3 million ounces in the same Archean belt. Barrick's willingness to fund grassroots exploration 60km from one of Quebec's largest undeveloped gold deposits is a geological endorsement that the district remains under-explored at depth. Midland's business model — funded partner earn-ins with majority royalties retained — has historically generated discovery-stage returns for shareholders at minimal dilution cost.

headline: RESOLUTE MINING GROWS ABC PROJECT TO 3.0 MILLION OUNCES — 39% RESOURCE JUMP IN CÔTE D'IVOIRE AFTER 31,000m OF DRILLING SINCE 2025 ACQUISITION (ASX: RSG)
snippet: Resolute Mining Limited (ASX: RSG) announced July 22 an updated Mineral Resource Estimate for the ABC Project in northwest Côte d'Ivoire, now standing at 133 million tonnes grading 0.71 g/t gold for 3.0 million ounces of contained gold — a 39% increase from the prior 2.16 million ounce estimate. Since acquiring the project in 2025, Resolute drilled 31,000m to confirm extensions outside prior block models, with both Kona South and Kona Central remaining open along strike and at depth. Seven drill rigs are currently on site, increasing to eleven in August, with $15–25 million in drilling and feasibility studies budgeted through 2027. For investors tracking West African gold, ABC now sits among the most significant undeveloped bulk-tonnage deposits on the continent — 3 million ounces at 0.71 g/t with an operator that has a demonstrated track record of bringing West African gold projects to production.

headline: ALL RARE EARTHS HIT 2026 HIGHS — NdPr ALLOY AT $133/kg, GERMANIUM +27.8%, DYSPROSIUM +25.4% AS SECOND SUPPLY DEFICIT DEEPENS
snippet: Every tracked rare earth element rose in July 2026 to new 2026 highs, led by germanium (+27.8%) and dysprosium (+25.4%), with NdPr alloy — the key magnet metal for EV motors and wind turbines — printing approximately $133/kg on the alloy benchmark as of July 1 and holding above that level through mid-month. The structural driver is a second consecutive annual supply deficit, with EV and wind turbine industrial demand consuming the majority of NdPr production globally. China controls approximately 92% of refined NdPr supply and 98–99% of separated heavy rare earths including dysprosium and terbium; MOFCOM export licensing tightened further in Q2 2026. For junior REE developers in stable western jurisdictions — particularly those with significant NdPr ratios and heavy rare earth profiles — the combination of record prices and accelerating government-backed domestic supply programs is creating a convergence of favourable economics and political will not seen since the 2011 rare earth spike.

headline: JEFFREY CHRISTIAN: CHINA'S GOLD 'SHOCK' IS NOT A SHOCK — SGE RETAIL PHASE-OUT TARGETS FRAUD, NOT MARKET STRUCTURE; PHYSICAL AND ETF CHANNELS UNAFFECTED
snippet: CPM Group founder Jeffrey Christian published July 24 analysis pushing back on viral claims that China's July 24 shutdown of retail leveraged paper gold products at the Shanghai Gold Exchange is a transformative moment that will 'dismantle Western price manipulation' or trigger a gold price explosion. Christian argues the change is narrower than headlines suggest: it targets only the small segment of retail leveraged synthetic positions that generated fraud and excessive investor losses during the $5,600-to-$4,000 gold drawdown. Physical gold bars, coins, savings plans, ETFs, Shanghai gold futures, and the SGE's institutional market are entirely unaffected. The article is a useful analytical brake for investors who may have overinterpreted this morning's news cycle — the structural bullish case for gold is intact, but it does not depend on this specific regulatory change.
